%@ 비밀번호를 자격 증명 관리자에 저장하지 못했어요. 이번 실행 중에만: Couldn't save the %@ password to Credential Manager. It will be remembered only while the app is running.
%USERPROFILE%\\.ssh\\known_hosts 에 있는 키는: Keys in %USERPROFILE%\.ssh\known_hosts aren't removed. If the changed key is in that file, remove it in Command Prompt with ssh-keygen -R.
MySQL · PostgreSQL · Redis 로고 (DB 종류 아이콘: MySQL, PostgreSQL and Redis logos (database type icons). Each logo is a trademark of its owner and is used only to indicate the database type.
Redis 서버가 %@초 안에 응답하지 않았어요. 주소 · 포트 · TL: The Redis server didn't respond within %@ seconds. Check the address, port, TLS setting and network (SSH tunnel).
SSH 개인키 파일은 넣지 않고 경로만 넣어요. 받는 PC 에도 같은 경: SSH private key files are not included, only their paths. The receiving PC needs the key at the same path.
SSH 서버 키가 바뀌었어요 — %@: The SSH server key has changed — %@
SSH 서버 키가 바뀌었어요. 서버를 다시 설치한 게 아니라면 중간에서: The SSH server key has changed. Unless the server was reinstalled, this may be a man-in-the-middle attack. Check with the administrator, then use [Remove Saved Key] (removes it from GodDB's own file only).
SSH 서버 키를 받지 못했어요 — %@: Couldn't get the SSH server key — %@
SSH 키 파일 또는 SSH 사용자 이름이 맞는지 확인해 주세요. 키 파: Check the SSH key file and SSH user name. The key file must be readable only by your account (file Properties > Security).
SSH 터널 안쪽은 127.0.0.1 이라 이름은 확인하지 않고, 고정한: Inside an SSH tunnel the address is 127.0.0.1, so the name isn't checked. Only the fingerprint is checked if a certificate is pinned.
SSH 호스트 키를 저장하지 못했어요: Couldn't save the SSH host key
Tab 자동완성 · Ctrl+Enter 커서 문장 실행 · Ctrl+Al: Tab complete · Ctrl+Enter run statement · Ctrl+Alt+Enter run all · Ctrl+Shift+Enter explain · Ctrl+/ comment · Ctrl+Alt+L format
VPN 연결을 확인해 주세요. 사내망 IP라면 Windows 방화벽이나: Check your VPN connection. For an internal IP, make sure Windows Firewall or company security software isn't blocking GodDB.
WHERE 없는 DELETE · UPDATE, TRUNCATE, DROP: Asks once more before DELETE or UPDATE without WHERE, TRUNCATE, DROP, and Redis FLUSHALL, FLUSHDB, KEYS and similar. The confirmation for changing data on production connections always appears regardless of this setting.
Windows 방화벽 또는 회사 보안 프로그램(백신·방화벽)에서 GodD: Allow GodDB in Windows Firewall or your company's security software (antivirus/firewall).
Windows 의 OpenSSH(ssh.exe) 로 터널을 열어요. 키: Opens the tunnel with Windows OpenSSH (ssh.exe). Only key file authentication is supported.
Windows 자격 증명 관리자에 비밀번호 저장: Save password in Windows Credential Manager
ssh 프로그램을 찾지 못했어요. Windows 설정 > 시스템 > 선택: Couldn't find the ssh program. Install "OpenSSH Client" in Windows Settings > System > Optional features.
⚠ SQL Server 는 앱에서만 막아요(서버에서 강제되지 않음). 운: ⚠ SQL Server is blocked by the app only (not enforced by the server). For production, use a database account with read-only permissions.
고른 접속을 JSON 파일 하나로 저장해요. 다른 PC 의 GodDB 에: Saves the selected connections to a single JSON file that GodDB on another PC can import.
끌어서 바꾼 상태창 · 편집기 · 패널 크기를 처음 크기로 되돌려요: Restore the log, editor and panel sizes you dragged to their defaults
날짜별 감사 로그(goddb-audit-날짜.tsv) 폴더를 열어요 (%: Opens the folder of daily audit logs (goddb-audit-date.tsv) (%LOCALAPPDATA%\GodDB\Logs)
바스티온의 호스트 키가 바뀌었어요. %USERPROFILE%\\.ssh\: The bastion's host key changed. Remove that host's line from %USERPROFILE%\.ssh\known_hosts and try again.
새 버전은 GitHub 릴리스에서 받아요. 사용자 폴더에 설치돼 관리자: New versions are downloaded from GitHub Releases. The app installs into your user folder, so no administrator rights are needed.
Make sure it matches the fingerprint you got from the server administrator.
서버 인증서가 바뀌었어요. 서버를 교체한 게 아니라면 중간에서 가로채는: The server certificate has changed. Unless the server was replaced, this may be a man-in-the-middle attack. Check with the administrator, then click [Remove Saved Certificate].
The connection closed before the server certificate was received.
Timed out while receiving the server certificate.
서버 인증서를 확인할 수 없어요 (%@). SHA-256: %@: Couldn't verify the server certificate (%@). SHA-256: %@
서버가 TLS 를 지원하지 않아요. TLS 를 끄거나 SSH 터널을 쓰세: The server doesn't support TLS. Turn TLS off or use an SSH tunnel.
The server sent an invalid TDS packet.
Couldn't read the server's PRELOGIN response.
선택 영역만 실행, 선택이 없으면 커서가 있는 문장(강조된 문장)만 실행: Run the selection, or only the statement at the cursor (the highlighted one) if nothing is selected (Ctrl+Enter)
설치된 앱에서만 업데이트를 확인할 수 있어요. (개발 실행): Updates can only be checked in the installed app. (development run)
스키마 전체 ER 다이어그램 (Ctrl/Shift 클릭으로 테이블을 여러: ER diagram of the whole schema (Ctrl/Shift-click to select several tables for just those)
시스템 신뢰 저장소로 인증서와 호스트 이름을 확인해요. 사설 인증서면 처: Checks the certificate and host name against the system trust store. For a private certificate, the fingerprint is shown on first connect and you're asked whether to pin it.
운영 접속 %@ 에 커밋하지 않은 변경이 있어 자동으로 끊지 않았어요: Production connection %@ has uncommitted changes, so it wasn't disconnected automatically
운영 접속 %@ 을 %@ 동안 쓰지 않아 끊었어요: Disconnected production connection %@ after %@ of inactivity
운영 접속을 이 시간 동안 쓰지 않으면 연결을 끊어요. 커밋하지 않은 변: Disconnects a production connection after this much idle time. If there are uncommitted changes it only warns. Query tabs stay, and running again reconnects.
위험한 명령 실행 전 확인을 껐어요: Turned off confirmation before dangerous statements
위험한 명령 실행 전 확인을 켰어요: Turned on confirmation before dangerous statements
This address is outside this PC. The query and table structures will be sent to that server.
인증서를 확인하지 않으면 중간에서 가로채도 알 수 없어요. 암호화만 해요: Without certificate verification, interception can't be detected. Only encryption is used.

읽기전용 접속에서는 실행할 수 없어요: %@ (문장 안에 있음): Can't run this on a read-only connection: %@ (found in the statement)
읽기전용 접속에서는 실행할 수 없어요: %@ (상태를 바꾸는 함수): Can't run this on a read-only connection: %@ (a function that changes state)
읽기전용 접속에서는 실행할 수 없어요: %@ (행을 잠금): Can't run this on a read-only connection: %@ (locks rows)
자격 증명 관리자에 저장된 비밀번호가 없어요 (또는 읽지 못했어요). 비: There is no password saved in Credential Manager (or it couldn't be read). Enter the password. If the DB has no password, leave it empty and connect.
A password is saved in Credential Manager.
저장된 비밀번호가 없어요. 입력 후 저장하면 자격 증명 관리자에 보관돼요: No saved password. Enter one and save to keep it in Credential Manager.

키 파일 권한이 너무 열려 있어요. 파일 속성 > 보안에서 본인 계정만: The key file permissions are too open. In file Properties > Security, allow only your account to read it.
편집기의 모든 문장(%@개, 변경 문 %@개)을 위에서부터 실행해요. 한: All statements in the editor (%@, including %@ that change data) run from the top. To run just one, put the cursor in it and press Ctrl+Enter.
편집기의 모든 문장을 위에서부터 실행 (Ctrl+Alt+Enter): Run every statement in the editor from the top (Ctrl+Alt+Enter)
